sketchMechanisms: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance exists, forever, with no constructor to call and no way to create another.
Optional chaining silently propagates nil — if any link in the chain is absent, the entire expression quietly evaluates to nil without error or complaint.
A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when there is no matching row on the right — the unmatched columns fill with NULL.
